description: This Java class acts as a global exception handler within a Spring Boot application, mapping specific and generic exceptions to custom HTTP responses with structured error details.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice class that handles exceptions globally across the application, converting them into standardized HTTP error responses.

methods.name: handleNoSuchElement
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException by returning a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException by returning a 400 Bad Request with validation error details per field.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions by returning a 500 Internal Server Error with exception message.
